'''Simonelle''' was an [[Ingoian]] scientist based in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. His enclave was hidden.

The doctor picked up experimentation with [[Human replica droid|HRDs]] when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Project Decoy]] failed; a pirated copy of a prototype [[droid/Legends|droid]], and the project's plans, came to his possession. Thanks to these, he created several "primitive" droids, before he made his masterpiece, [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] assassin droid, [[Guri]].<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Xizor paid nine million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy Guri, however Simonelle secretly used the credits (and the experience) to build a [[Simonelle (droid)|replica droid of himself]]. He also started creating other droids in [[Simonelle's workshop|his workshop]]. Xizor however prized Guri so much that he didn't wish her creator to lessen her value or being threatened by droids with Guri's abilities.<ref name="one">{{WEGCite|story=Only One of Her Kind|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

Luckily, Simonelle was in a distant room, with his replica working, when Xizor sent Guri to his workshop to kill her own creator. The [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] watched at a [[Viewscreen|vid-screen]] as Guri stroke "his" head before strangling him. Guri neglected destroying the doctor's work before leaving. After watching all these, Simonelle started planning his disappearance to fake his death.<ref name="one" />
